subject: SOC 2 recertification & renewal: log window, evidence handoff, and seat onramp
messages:
From: Elaine Park <elaine.park@synthware.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Mayer <tmayer@procure.synthware.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SOC 2 recert & renewal — log retention window + capacity uplift

Hi Tessa,

Hope you’re well. Our renewal with Redwood lands on 2026-12-15 and our security team is asking for an updated SOC 2 recertification plan tied to the renewal. Two items we need to align on ASAP for contract negotiations: 

- Audit log retention: current contract has 90 days. For our compliance we need a path to 365 days. Please confirm whether you can support 365d retention, and what the storage/ingestion cost delta looks like.
- Throughput / burst: our product team expects a 2x peak traffic period during Black Friday testing next November. We want a committed seat uplift (additional 4 seats + burst capacity) and clarity on SLA for those seats.

Can you send a single checklist of required evidence (e.g., which logs, sample formats) and a recommended handoff method? I’ve attached our internal SOC2 checklist to speed this up.

Appreciate a quick telco this week if possible — we’d like numbers to present to procurement by Oct 26.

Thanks,
Elaine Park
Head of Security, Synthware
elaine.park@synthware.com

Attachment: synthware_soc2_checklist.pdf (pdf)

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Elaine Park <elaine.park@synthware.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 16 Oct 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC 2 recert & renewal — log retention window + capacity uplift

Hi Elaine — thanks for the clear ask and the checklist. Cc’ing our security and infra leads so we can give you an actionable plan.

High level summary of what we’ll deliver for your Oct 26 procurement checkpoint:
- A clear evidence pack template (what fields, file naming, and sample ingestion artifacts) + preferred transfer methods (SFTP / secure Drive + audit trail).
- Cost delta estimate for moving from 90d -> 365d retention, with a line-item for storage and egress.
- Proposal for seat uplift (4 committed seats) and a burst-capacity add-on for Nov testing, plus an SLA addendum for the uplift window.
- Draft contract amendment (term & pricing) you can share with procurement.

Action items for us: Karthik — can you run a quick capacity+cost calc and a ballpark discount for a 12-month commit on the extra seats? Kimberly — can you confirm whether we have any operational limitations on providing 365d searchable logs for Synthware’s tenancy (I think we do, but need to confirm retention indexing overhead).

Elaine — I’ll schedule a 30-min sync for Monday Oct 19; please let me know if morning Pacific works. I’ve also attached our internal evidence playbook for reference.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
tessa.morgan@redwood.ai

Attachments: redwood_evidence_playbook.pdf (pdf)

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 16 Oct 2026 11:07:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: SOC 2 recert & renewal — log retention window + capacity uplift

Kimberly / Karthik — forwarding Elaine’s checklist and initial asks. Key asks summarized below (procurement needs numbers by 10/26):

- Retention upgrade: 90d -> 365d (searchable audit logs). Estimate incremental storage (monthly) and expected indexing overhead. Also note any compliance/regulatory constraints (EU residency, PII handling).
- Seats: +4 committed seats for 12 months starting at renewal (2026-12-15). Additionally request burst capacity for a 72-hour test window in Nov 2027 (2x traffic). Provide pricing for committed seats vs on-demand and a recommended SLA addendum language.
- Evidence handoff: Elaine prefers SFTP or secure Drive with audit logs. We should propose a secure transfer plan and whether we can provide a hashed checksum manifest.

Can you both aim to have an initial internal estimate by Monday morning so I can present to Elaine on the sync?

Thanks — Tessa

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 19 Oct 2026 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: SOC 2 recert & renewal — log retention window + capacity uplift

Tessa / Kimberly — quick pass on numbers and constraints.

Retention (90 -> 365 days):
- Estimated incremental storage: ~2.8 TB/month (based on Synthware’s avg token ingestion over last 90 days) -> ~33.6 TB/yr.
- Storage rate: $0.025/GB/month for cold-tier retention (our internal rate) -> incremental ~ $840/mo (list).
- Indexing/searchability overhead: expect +15-20% CPU/IO overhead during rebuild periods; recommend a rolling index approach to avoid full reindex during audits.

Seats / burst:
- Committed seats (4 additional): list price $1,200/seat/month -> committed price we can offer $1,020/seat/month with a 12-month commitment (15% discount).
- Burst window (72h, 2x peak): we can provide dedicated burst nodes for $2,500 flat for the window (includes prewarming & KV cache warmup) OR alternately allow on-demand scaling billed at usage.

Operational notes:
- We can deliver searchable logs for 365d but will require an amendment to the terms (audit log retention addendum).
- Evidence handoff: SFTP with PGP + checksum manifest is preferred for sensitive corp datasets; Drive link with audit logs can be an option if Synthware prefers.

Attachments: capacity_calc.xlsx (xlsx) — rough capacity and cost calc.

If Kimberly confirms we're good on the retention indexing side, I’ll draft numbers for Tessa to share with Elaine on the call.

—Karthik

On Fri, Oct 16, 2026 at 11:07 AM Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Kimberly / Karthik — forwarding Elaine’s checklist and initial asks....

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Elaine Park <elaine.park@synthware.com>
Cc: Tom Mayer <tmayer@procure.synthware.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Oct 2026 11:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC 2 recert & renewal — log retention window + capacity uplift

Elaine / team — quick confirmation on operational feasibility.

- We can support 365d searchable retention; the key caveat is that long-term retention will live in the cold tier with a warm index for the most recent 90 days. Full-text search across the full 365d will incur higher query latency for deep-history hits. We’ll document expected query latency profiles in the evidence pack.
- For evidence transfer we recommend SFTP + checksum or a shared Drive folder with Drive audit logs enabled. We cannot support direct streaming of PII into customer-managed buckets for SOC2 evidence by default without a Private deployment (we can discuss as an alternative).

Next steps we propose:
1) Redwood delivers a draft amendment (term + pricing + SLA addendum) for Synthware review.
2) We agree an evidence handoff window and method (Elaine, please confirm preference).
3) Karthik to send final cost numbers and I will add the operational caveats to the amendment.

Happy to jump on the Monday call as well.

Kimberly Park
Senior Security Program Manager, Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.ai

Subject: Re: SOC 2 recert & renewal — log retention window + capacity uplift

Elaine / Tom — thanks for the call today. Quick summary and confirmed next steps so procurement has what they need for internal approval: 

1) Retention: Redwood will provide 365-day searchable audit logs. Operational model: 0-90d hot index; 91-365d cold tier with query latency caveat documented. Incremental cost: ~$840/month (line item on amendment).
2) Seats: +4 committed seats at $1,020/seat/month with a 12-month term starting 2026-12-15.
3) Burst window: Dedicated burst nodes for the planned 72h test window (Nov 2027) available for a flat $2,500 fee (includes prewarming). Alternative: on-demand scaling at usage rates.
4) Evidence handoff: Primary method = SFTP with PGP + checksum manifest. Secondary: shared Drive with Drive audit enabled.
5) Contract: I’ve attached a draft amendment (term/pricing/SLA language) for your review. We’ll prepare a DocuSign envelope for signature after you confirm the handoff method and the commit.

Please review the attached draft amendment and the cost calc. If everything looks good, I’ll send a DocuSign link by close of day Wed 10/21 so your procurement team can route it.

Next steps for Redwood (owners): Karthik — finalize the cost calc into a table for the amendment. Kimberly — add the operational language and an evidence transfer checklist. Tessa — prepare DocuSign and HubSpot deal update (deal SW-2026-089).

Elaine — let me know if you want us to include a short addendum that calls out data residency or PII handling specifics ahead of procurement routing.

Thanks,
Tessa Morgan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
tessa.morgan@redwood.ai

Attachments: draft_amendment.docx (docx); capacity_calc.xlsx (xlsx)
